s2.ptxt: Using brake cleaner, clean the inside, threads and O-ring groove of the oil filter cap.
Apply a small amount of engine oil to a new O-ring (for cap) and install it to the oil filter cap.
Set a new oil filter element into the oil filter cap.
Remove any dirt and foreign matter from the installation surface and inside on the engine side.
Apply a small amount of engine oil to the O-ring (for cap) again, and install the oil filter cap.

atten3.ptxt: Do not pinch the O-ring (for cap).

s2.ptxt: Using SST, tighten the oil filter cap.

atten3.ptxt: After tightening the oil filter cap, check that there is no clearance at the installation surface.

s2.ptxt: Apply a small amount of engine oil to a new O-ring (for drain plug) and install it to the oil filter cap.

atten3.ptxt: Remove any dirt and foreign matter from the installation surface.

s2.ptxt: Install the oil filter drain plug to the oil filter cap.

atten3.ptxt: Do not pinch the O-ring (for drain plug).

s2.ptxt: Warm up and stop the engine; after 5 minutes, check that the oil level is between the L and F marks on the oil level gauge. If the oil level is low, check for leaks and add oil up to the F mark.
Start the engine and check that there is no oil leaking from the joints of the oil filter cap, oil filter drain plug and oil pan drain plug.

s-1.ptxt: Install Oil Filter Element Service Hole Cover

s2.ptxt: As shown in the illustration, fold the service hole cover toward the top of the vehicle, then unfold the crease.

atten4.ptxt: If the crease is not unfolded, the service hole cover may appear raised after installation.

s2.ptxt: Install the service hole cover with the clips.
